planned.summary: Build-order step 1 — deploy the merged ops image, no Caddy change. https://cartracker.info/ still serves the pre-plan copy while 1b, 1d, 1e and 1f are all on master; the template needs no route change, so this is separable from Stage 6, and it is currently untracked in Linear. Then Stage 2 (CAR-62) — the public root, the /info redirect and the recap routes: the unlock that makes / the front door and gives 1e's 20 generated pages a URL, carrying this plan's riskiest change. Write Stage 5's Streamlit-coupling assertion as part of that stage, not after it — Gate 2 as written cannot see the failure mode. Stage 1h built 2026-09-01 (PR #335), with Gate 1h's demonstration half still owed a closeout run against the merged skill. Stage 1g remains not executable — blocked on 3d's two open decisions, which govern its markup

planned.title: Cycle-close ritual
planned.summary: Stage 0 — write the close order down, then Stage 3's git-ref and worktree hygiene; both are independent of Linear and buildable now

completed.title: The testing contract
completed.summary: The rules for how this project tests itself used to be a paragraph of documentation that slowly went out of date. They are now a contract the suite checks on every change, so the description cannot quietly stop matching the code.

completed.title: Test suite maintenance
completed.summary: Made test coverage visible on every change instead of measured and thrown away, and fixed a test database that did not match the shape of the real one.

completed.title: Scrape state ownership
completed.summary: Split one timestamp into two: when a listing was last fetched, and when it was last understood. A backlog in one stage no longer causes the same pages to be fetched over and over.

completed.title: Coordination gate deadlock
completed.summary: A deploy could wait forever on a signal that was never sent, and looked like it was working while it hung. The signal is now recorded correctly, and a wait that cannot finish fails with the reason named instead of hanging.
